items.title: 2 Financials Stocks to Keep an Eye On and 1 We Find Risky
items.summary: Financial firms serve as the backbone of the economy, providing essential services from lending and investment management to risk management and payment processing. These companies have benefited from improving market activity and economic fundamentals, so it’s no surprise the industry has posted a 13% gain over the past six months, nearly mirroring the S&P 500.

items.title: 5 Revealing Analyst Questions From eBay’s Q2 Earnings Call
items.summary: eBay’s second quarter results were met with a negative market reaction despite surpassing Wall Street expectations for both revenue and non-GAAP profit. Management pointed to strong execution in focused categories, such as collectibles and fashion, as well as significant growth in the consumer-to-consumer (C2C) and recommerce segments. CEO Jamie Iannone highlighted that over 70% of gross merchandise volume (GMV) came from these strategic priorities, with each growing more than 20% year-over-year

items.title: GameStop’s Ryan Cohen Considers Scrapping $56B eBay Takeover for Store Partnership
items.summary: Three months after Ryan Cohen startled Wall Street with an unsolicited $56 billion bid for eBay Inc. (NASDAQ:EBAY), GameStop Corp. (NYSE:GME)’s CEO appears to be backing away from it. Bloomberg reported on August 10 that Cohen is considering withdrawing the offer entirely and replacing it with something far more modest: a partnership or joint venture. […]
